info.title: mpia
info.description:
Documentation-only OpenAPI view of the mpia macOS data CLI. Paths mirror the CLI command tree (CLI-faithful) with slash-separated subcommands; query parameters are CLI flags.

HTTP methods are a semantic mapping:
- OPTIONS for permission/discovery/verification
- HEAD for scalar metadata
- GET for reads
- POST for create/execute/export
- PUT for full replace
- PATCH for partial edit
- DELETE for removal

Write-safety (dry-run/apply/confirmation) and exit codes are preserved as x-* extensions.
